sla.legacy_import_policy: SLA starts at registry adoption for pre-existing pending tasks.

records.acceptance: A future approved authenticated ChatGPT-compatible connector consumes one opaque selector-resolved outbox reference, verifies envelope/artifact identity and hash, and delivers the compact review bundle without public exposure, arbitrary paths, secrets, archive mutation or production-batch coupling.
records.monitoring: Until an approved connector capability exists, verify review_bundle/outbox determinism and preserve DIRECT_CHATGPT_TRANSPORT_PENDING_EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY; do not represent GCP filesystem or local export paths as direct ChatGPT access.
